#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: wait-idle.sh <phase> [deadline_seconds]
# Read-only bounded polling (system ping + get_editor_state). Needs 2 consecutive idle readings.
EV=/private/tmp/issue376-evidence/2022.3.62f3-final
CLI=/Users/akiojin/Workbench/unity-cli/work/issue-376/target/debug/unity-cli
PROJ=/private/tmp/issue376-unity-2022.3.62f3-final
phase="$1"; deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + ${2:-180} ))
cd "$PROJ" || exit 99
log="$EV/$phase/poll.log"; idle=0
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] ($phase/poll) loop: $CLI --project-path $PROJ --port 6549 --output json system ping / raw get_editor_state --json '{}' every 3s, deadline ${2:-180}s" >> "$EV/commands.txt"
while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
  p=$("$CLI" --project-path "$PROJ" --port 6549 --output json --timeout-ms 5000 system ping 2>&1)
  s=$("$CLI" --project-path "$PROJ" --port 6549 --output json --timeout-ms 5000 raw get_editor_state --json '{}' 2>&1)
  pp=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.projectPath // "ERR"' 2>/dev/null || echo ERR)
  st=$(echo "$s" | jq -c '.state|{isCompiling,isUpdating,isPlaying}' 2>/dev/null || echo ERR)
  echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) project=$pp state=$st" | tee -a "$log"
  if [ "$pp" = "$PROJ" ] && [ "$st" = '{"isCompiling":false,"isUpdating":false,"isPlaying":false}' ]; then
    idle=$((idle+1)); [ $idle -ge 2 ] && { echo "$s" > "$EV/$phase/editor-state-final.json"; echo IDLE; exit 0; }
  else idle=0; fi
  sleep 3
done
echo TIMEOUT; exit 1
